---
name: Design question or proposal
about: Something about how the game should work, rather than a defect
labels: design
---

**The question or the proposal, in a sentence.**

**What it changes.** If it touches scope, it lands in `docs/DESIGN.md` and needs
a row in `docs/DECISIONS.md` (ADR-006 — assistants draft, humans ratify). Saying
which section you mean saves a round trip.

**Which pillar it serves, or fights.** The six are at the top of `DESIGN.md`.
The interesting proposals are usually the ones that trade one against another,
and naming the trade is most of the argument.

**What it would cost to reverse.** Cheap-to-reverse ideas can be tried; the
expensive ones are what the decision log is for.
